chunks: And it was narrated from Ṣafwān, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who slanders a man from the pre-Islamic Arabs. He said: "He is to be given the legal punishment."
I said: "Is he to be given the legal punishment?" He said: "Yes, indeed that reaches the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله."

key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.يَفْتَرِي: to fabricate a false accusation or slander
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be struck or subjected to punishment

ai.seo_question: Is slandering a person from the pre-Islamic Arabs punishable in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that slandering a person from the pre-Islamic Arabs is subject to hadd punishment. The Imam عليه السلام explains that such an offense affects the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, indicating the gravity of attacking those connected to his lineage and people.
